board: Adafruit STEMMA Soil Sensor - I2C Capacitive Moisture Sensor (#4026)
reason: Modelled as a seesaw i2c-device at 0x36 that answers command responses (HW_ID 00 01 = 0x55, moisture 0F 10 = 16-bit big-endian count, temperature 00 04 = signed 32-bit 16.16 fixed point). The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
